Gale Academic OneFile, 76 Appendix A Preliminary mechanical properties evaluation made on SMC-V1 30wt% - 1” length glass/vinyl ester SMC produced on the SMC-V1 was compression molded into plates of nominal thickness 3.5 mm. ASTM flexure strength and modulus, and interlaminar shear strength (ILSS) was measured for the machine direction (MD) and cross direction (CD) to evaluate the effect of fiber orientation if any. Figure 95 and 96 summarize the flexural strength and modulus, while Figure 97 summarizes the ILSS. The average flexural strength was recorded to be 170.5 MPa for the MD and 161.3 for the CD. The corresponding flexural modulus was 10.8 (MD) and 9.6 (CD) respectively. The ILSS was 14.2 MPa (MD) and 13.6 MPa (CD) This indicates isotropic material condition, with slightly higher fiber orientation along the MD. See figures 95 to 97.
